item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Fall Out Boy - Discography in Dolby Atmos
item.description:
(Note for rule compliance - All versions of this existing on here have been lost with no engagement from posters upon reup requests)

Looking for a rip of all eight Fall Out Boy albums in their dolby atmos mix, they sound truly different in that format (certain guitar parts or backing vocals for example are mixed so that they take the forefront of the mix, however I havent been able to find a way to reliably rip myself. I put an example below of a song with its normal mix and how it sounds under the Dolby Atmos mix for reference, if you rip the dolby and it sounds identical to the first one youve got the same problem as I had before asking here and its just giving you the regular flac in its regular mix.

REGULAR EXAMPLE
DOLBY ATMOS EXAMPLE

ALBUMS
  1. Take This to Your Grave (2003)
  2. From Under the Cork Tree (2005)
  3. Infinity on High (2007)
  4. Folie à Deux (2008)
  5. Save Rock and Roll (2013)
  6. American Beauty/American Psycho (2015)
  7. Mania (2018)

Thanks!
